scope: 180-image NEU-DET test split; final detections only

roles.correctness_authority: real NEU-DET test split Pascal VOC ground truth
roles.diagnostic_control: TRT M3 selective; actual FP16 tactic count 0; M3_DEGENERATED_TO_FP32

classwise_risk_report.descriptive_trigger: any Original FP16 class AP50 or recall absolute drop greater than 0.10 versus FP32

evaluator.confidence: use detections after frozen confidence threshold 0.25; sort descending confidence
evaluator.matching: class-aware one-to-one matching; highest IoU eligible ground truth per prediction
evaluator.integration: mean precision envelope at recall points 0.00 through 1.00
evaluator.iou_coordinate_semantics: exclusive width/height: max(0, x2-x1) and max(0, y2-y1)
evaluator.candidate_order: not used as a matching priority; deterministic geometry/class tie-break only

timing.faster_rule: ORIGINAL_FP16_TASK_TIMING_FASTER only if Original FP16 mean inference and mean E2E are both lower than FP32 under this same protocol
timing.inconclusive_rule: otherwise ORIGINAL_FP16_TASK_TIMING_NOT_FASTER or ORIGINAL_FP16_TASK_TIMING_INCONCLUSIVE is reported; M3 timing is not used

frozen_inputs.postprocessing: confidence 0.25, IoU 0.45, max_nms 30000, max_det 300, max_wh 7680, agnostic false, multi_label false
